    13	/-!
    14	# Descent-backed rank-one certificates for a tied cocycle datum
    15	
    16	This file is the cohomological half of the native family contract.  A certificate is attached to
    17	the displayed `BasicOpenCocycleDatum` and its displayed affine representative; it is never a
    18	certificate for a separately chosen module.  The only geometric input is the fibre witness
    19	condition (the mapped Čech class has a divisor with vanishing `H¹`), from which the datum
    20	dictionary and the rigid engine derive the three cohomological conclusions.
    21	
    22	The descent stage is essential: arbitrary coefficient rings need not be Noetherian.  We descend
    23	the finite cocycle datum to a finitely generated subalgebra, fire the engine there, and transport
    24	`H¹`, finite projectivity, and stalk rank through the on-the-nose datum H⁰ base-change
    25	equivalence.  Thus the public conclusions are genuinely arbitrary-affine, while the only
    26	Noetherian instance is local to the constructed stage.
    27	-/

    53	/-- A field-parametrised vanishing witness for the *displayed* cocycle datum.
    54	
    55	This is deliberately an abbreviation for the landed `HasWitnessH1Vanishing` predicate.  In
    56	particular its divisor has the class of this datum's cocycle; it cannot be replaced by a witness
    57	for an unrelated module or class.  The stage constructor below asks for this predicate on its
    58	finitely generated descent datum, where every stage residue field is an admissible coefficient
    59	extension. -/
    60	abbrev BasicOpenCocycleDatum.FibreH1Witness
    61	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi) : Prop :=
    62	  ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra B L]
    63	    [IsScalarTower k B L], D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing L
    64	
    65	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    66	
    67	/-- The fibre witness is converted through the landed two-way datum dictionary. -/
    68	theorem subsingleton_pairH1_tensor_of_fibreWitness
    69	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi) (hW : D.FibreH1Witness)
    70	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra B L]
    71	    [IsScalarTower k B L] :
    72	    Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] L) :=
    73	  (D.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_subsingleton L).mp (hW L)

    75	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum

    79	/-- The four cohomological certificates consumed by the native presentation.

    81	Every module in this structure is the H-module of the same `D.sheaf`; no native or unrelated

    86	  h0_finite : Module.Finite B (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0)

    98	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    99	    (relCurve C L).Over (Spec (.of L)) :=

   109	    IsIntegral (relCurve C L) :=

   113	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
   114	    QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=

   127	/-! ## Canonical scalar extension -/
   128	
   129	/-- The canonical H⁰ equivalence attached to a certificate. -/
   130	noncomputable def h0BaseChange
   131	    (P : RankOneFamilyCertificates D)
   132	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
   133	    [IsScalarTower k B B'] :
   134	    B' ⊗[B] (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) ≃ₗ[B']
   135	      Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 0 := by
   136	  exact D.datumH0BaseChange B' ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff D).mpr P.h1_vanishing)
   137	
   138	omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   139	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] in
   140	/-- H¹ vanishing is preserved by the same canonical coefficient extension. -/
   141	theorem h1_baseChange
   142	    (P : RankOneFamilyCertificates D)
   143	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
   144	    [IsScalarTower k B B'] :
   145	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 1) :=
   146	  D.datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange B'
   147	    ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff D).mpr P.h1_vanishing)
   148	
   149	/- The finite/projective instances for a tensor product are installed in the next constructor,
   150	   where they are used to transport the package's source module along `h0BaseChange`. -/
   151	
   152	/-- Scalar extension transports all four certificates, with the target still `D.baseChange`. -/
   153	noncomputable def scalarExtension
   154	    (P : RankOneFamilyCertificates D)
   155	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
   156	    [IsScalarTower k B B'] :
   157	    RankOneFamilyCertificates (D.baseChange B') := by
   158	  let Q := Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0
   159	  letI : Module.Finite B Q := P.h0_finite
   160	  letI : Module.Projective B Q := P.h0_projective
   161	  let e : B' ⊗[B] Q ≃ₗ[B']
   162	      Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 0 := P.h0BaseChange B'
   163	  letI : Module.Finite B' (B' ⊗[B] Q) := by infer_instance
   164	  letI : Module.Projective B' (B' ⊗[B] Q) := by infer_instance
   165	  refine {
   166	    h1_vanishing := P.h1_baseChange B'
   167	    h0_finite := Module.Finite.equiv e
   168	    h0_projective := Module.Projective.of_equiv e
   169	    h0_rank_one := ?_ }
   170	  intro p
   171	  rw [← Module.rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv e, Module.rankAtStalk_baseChange]
   172	  exact P.h0_rank_one (p.comap (algebraMap B B'))

   176	set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
   177	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
   178	/-- Construct the certificate package after a genuine finitely generated descent stage.
   179	
   180	`hW₀` is the fibre-divisor/H¹ antecedent at the stage and `hdegree` is the corresponding
   181	class-degree calculation.  Neither field mentions the desired H¹/H⁰/rank conclusions.  The
   182	Noetherian instance is created only for `B₀`; the result is over the original, unrestricted
   183	ring `B` by the canonical datum base-change equivalence. -/
   184	noncomputable def of_descent_stage
   185	    {B₀ : Subalgebra k B} (hfg : B₀.FG)
   186	    (D₀ : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C (↥B₀) pi)
   187	    (hbc : D₀.baseChange (B' := B) = D)
   188	    (hπ : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   189	    (hW₀ : D₀.FibreH1Witness)
   190	    (hdegree : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum (↥B₀),
   191	      classDeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   192	        (D₀.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).cechPicClass = (genus C : ℤ)) :
   193	    RankOneFamilyCertificates D := by
   194	  subst D
   195	  letI : IsNoetherianRing (↥B₀) := hfg.isNoetherianRing
   196	  have hfib : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum (↥B₀),
   197	      Subsingleton ((datumPair D₀).H1 ⊗[↥B₀] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
   198	    intro p
   199	    exact D₀.subsingleton_pairH1_tensor_of_fibreWitness hW₀
   200	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   201	  obtain ⟨h1₀, hfin₀, hproj₀⟩ :=
   202	    BasicOpenCocycleDatum.descentRigidEngine hfg D₀ hπ hfib
   203	  have hpair₀ : Subsingleton (datumPair D₀).H1 :=
   204	    (subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff D₀).mpr h1₀
   205	  have hrank₀ : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum (↥B₀),
   206	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D₀.sheaf 0) p = 1 := by
   207	    intro p
   208	    haveI : IsIntegral (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   209	      instIsIntegralBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   210	    haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
   211	        (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘
   212	          Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :=
   213	      instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   214	    haveI : QuasiCompact
   215	        (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘
   216	          Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :=
   217	      instQuasiCompactBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   218	    haveI : Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   219	        (Sheaf.HModule
   220	          ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 0) :=
   221	      instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   222	    haveI : Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   223	        (Sheaf.HModule
   224	          ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1) :=
   225	      instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   226	    exact BasicOpenCocycleDatum.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one D₀ (n := genus C) hπ
   227	      (chi_moduleKSheaf C) hfib p (hdegree p)
   228	  let Q := Sheaf.HModule D₀.sheaf 0
   229	  letI : Module.Finite (↥B₀) Q := hfin₀
   230	  letI : Module.Projective (↥B₀) Q := hproj₀
   231	  let e : B ⊗[↥B₀] Q ≃ₗ[B]
   232	      Sheaf.HModule (D₀.baseChange (B' := B)).sheaf 0 :=
   233	    D₀.datumH0BaseChange B hpair₀
   234	  letI : Module.Finite B (B ⊗[↥B₀] Q) := by infer_instance
   235	  letI : Module.Projective B (B ⊗[↥B₀] Q) := by infer_instance
   236	  refine {
   237	    h1_vanishing := D₀.datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange B hpair₀
   238	    h0_finite := Module.Finite.equiv e
   239	    h0_projective := Module.Projective.of_equiv e
   240	    h0_rank_one := ?_ }
   241	  intro p
   242	  rw [← Module.rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv e, Module.rankAtStalk_baseChange]
   243	  exact hrank₀ (p.comap (algebraMap (↥B₀) B))
   244	
   245	end RankOneFamilyCertificates

   247	end AlgebraicGeometry

   933	set_option maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
   934	-- Heartbeat headroom for the section-formula transports and the tensor-bridge
   935	-- instance searches, as elsewhere in the Lane-F section-formula layer.
   936	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   937	/-- **Stacks 02KG (`i = 0`, affine case), affine-chart form**: for a cartesian
   938	square with `f` (hence `f'`) affine, a quasi-coherent `F` on `X`, and affine
   939	opens `V ⊆ Y`, `O ⊆ Y'` with `O ≤ g⁻¹V`, the canonical base-change comparison
   940	`g^*(f_* F) ⟶ f'_*((g')^* F)` is an isomorphism on sections over `O`.  **No
   941	flatness of `g` is required.**  Both sides are identified with the two scalar
   942	extensions of `Γ(F, f⁻¹V)` by the affine section formula
   943	(`pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_sectionLinearEquiv`), the identifications are
   944	intertwined by the mate–unit formula on the `Γ(Y', O)`-generators, and the
   945	resulting bridge `Γ(Y', O) ⊗_{Γ(Y, V)} M ⟶ Γ(X', f'⁻¹O) ⊗_{Γ(X, f⁻¹V)} M` is
   946	bijective by associativity of scalar extension along the section-ring pushout
   947	(`SectionBaseChange.bijective_addHom_of_isPushout` +
   948	`isPushout_appLE_of_isPullback`). -/
   949	theorem isIso_pushforwardBaseChangeMap_app_of_isPullback
   950	    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g' : X' ⟶ X}
   951	    (h : IsPullback g' f' f g) [IsAffineHom f] [IsAffineHom f']
   952	    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
   953	    {V : Y.Opens} {O : Y'.Opens} (e : O ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
   954	    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hO : IsAffineOpen O) :
   955	    IsIso (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (pushforwardBaseChangeMap f g f' g' h.w F) O) := by
   956	  -- opens bookkeeping

   958	    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, h.w, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
   959	    exact f'.preimage_mono e
   960	  have hfV : IsAffineOpen (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) := hV.preimage f
   961	  have hf'O : IsAffineOpen (f' ⁻¹ᵁ O) := hO.preimage f'
   962	  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F).IsQuasicoherent :=
   963	    Scheme.Modules.pushforward_isQuasicoherent f F
   964	  -- the algebra dictionary of the section-ring square

   967	    (f.appLE V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl).hom.toAlgebra
   968	  letI aCD : Algebra Γ(X, f ⁻¹ᵁ V) Γ(X', f' ⁻¹ᵁ O) :=
   969	    (g'.appLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ O) e').hom.toAlgebra
   970	  letI aBD : Algebra Γ(Y', O) Γ(X', f' ⁻¹ᵁ O) :=
   971	    (f'.appLE O (f' ⁻¹ᵁ O) le_rfl).hom.toAlgebra
   972	  letI aAD : Algebra Γ(Y, V) Γ(X', f' ⁻¹ᵁ O) :=
   973	    ((f.appLE V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl) ≫
   974	      (g'.appLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ O) e')).hom.toAlgebra
   975	  have hsq : (f.appLE V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl) ≫ (g'.appLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ O) e') =
   976	      (g.appLE V O e) ≫ (f'.appLE O (f' ⁻¹ᵁ O) le_rfl) :=
   977	    (isPushout_appLE_of_isPullback h e e' hV hO hfV hf'O).w

   131	  have hmor : ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).inv ≫
   132	        (snd C (overSpec k B)).left.appLE ⊤ W
   133	          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k B)).left).ge)) ≫
   134	      (relCurveMap C B B').appLE W W' hle =
   135	      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B B') ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B')).inv ≫
   136	        (snd C (overSpec k B')).left.appLE ⊤ W'
   137	          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k B')).left).ge) := by
   138	    have hnat : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).inv ≫
   139	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B B'))).appTop =
   140	        CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B B') ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B')).inv := by

   142	        ← Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B B')),

   150	            (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top _).ge ≫

   154	    have happ : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B B'))).appLE ⊤ ⊤
   155	        (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top _).ge =

   157	      Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _

   159	      appLE_congr_hom (relCurveMap_snd C B B'), hsplit, happ, ← Category.assoc,

   164	          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k B)).left).ge)).hom

   169	          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k B')).left).ge)).hom

    10	# Affine-target descent for the pushforward base-change mate
    11	
    12	The B3 campaign gate `Scheme.HasRigidPushforward` (`Picard/RigidPushforward.lean`:373) has two
    13	fields.  `Picard/RigidPushforwardGate.lean` ("Caveat on the `baseChange` field") and
    14	`Picard/RigidPushforwardFrontier.lean` (item 3 of "What remains") both record that the second
    15	one, `Scheme.RigidPushforwardBaseChange` (`Picard/RigidPushforward.lean`:342), has **no
    16	infrastructure at all**: every `IsIso` theorem for the adjoint mate `pushforwardBaseChangeMap`
    17	in this tree (`isIso_pushforwardBaseChangeMap_of_isPullback`,
    18	`Picard/RigidPushforwardTransfer.lean`:1108, and its chart form :949) assumes `[IsAffineHom f]`,
    19	whereas the gate's family `q : C_A ⟶ Spec A` is proper and emphatically not affine.
    20	
    21	This file replaces "no infrastructure" by a named, honest **reduction**: the whole field follows
    22	from a single classical `H⁰`-base-change bijectivity of `Γ(Spec A, ⊤)`-modules.  It does not
    23	prove that bijectivity; `Picard/RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange.lean` does
    24	(`Adelic.rigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange_proved`), by the route sketched below.  It does not
    25	smuggle in the non-affine case either: only the two *bases* of the square are assumed affine,
    26	the fibre map `f` is arbitrary.
    27	
    28	## The reduction, in four steps
    29	
    30	* **§1 — affine-target descent.**  `Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isIso_moduleSpecΓFunctor_map` and
    31	  `Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_bijective_appTop`: a morphism `φ : M ⟶ N` of quasi-coherent modules
    32	  on an affine scheme is an isomorphism as soon as it is *bijective on global sections*.  The
    33	  input is the affine structure theorem `Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent`
    34	  (Stacks 01I8, `Picard/QuotScheme.lean`:2693) — the counit `Γ(M, ⊤)~ ⟶ M` is an isomorphism
    35	  for quasi-coherent `M` — together with naturality of `Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓNatTrans`.
    36	  Naturality rewrites `φ` as `fromTildeΓ_M⁻¹ ≫ (Γφ)~ ≫ fromTildeΓ_N`, a composite of three
    37	  isomorphisms, and the resulting `Iso` has `φ` as its `hom` by `rfl`.
    38	
    39	* **§2 — the mate on global sections.**  `isIso_pushforwardBaseChangeMap_appTop_of_bijective`:
    40	  over affine bases the `Γ(⊤)`-component of `pushforwardBaseChangeMap` *is* the canonical map
    41	  `Γ(Y', ⊤) ⊗_{Γ(Y, ⊤)} Γ(f_* F, ⊤) → Γ(f'_* (g'^* F), ⊤)`, `b ⊗ x ↦ b · baseMap x`.  The
    42	  source side is identified with the tensor product by
    43	  `pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_sectionLinearEquiv` (`Picard/QuotScheme.lean`:4611) and the
    44	  formula for the mate on the image of `baseMap` is `pushforwardBaseChangeMap_app_baseMap`
    45	  (`Picard/RigidPushforwardTransfer.lean`:828) taken at `V = O = ⊤`; simple tensors are handled
    46	  by `b ⊗ x = b • (1 ⊗ x)` and `Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul`, and `TensorProduct.induction_on`
    47	  propagates.
    48	
    49	  **Caveat, stated once and meant.**  §2 and §3 assume only `comm : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g`; the square
    50	  is *not* assumed cartesian.  They are therefore exactly as strong as the bijectivity `hbij`
    51	  handed to them, and must **not** be read as an unconditional Beck–Chevalley/base-change
    52	  theorem: all the mathematical content of a base-change theorem still sits inside `hbij`, and
    53	  without a cartesian square there is no reason for `hbij` to hold at all.
    54	
    55	* **§3 — the two combined.**  `isIso_pushforwardBaseChangeMap_of_bijective_gamma`: with `Y`
    56	  affine and the target of `g` of the form `Spec R'`, quasi-coherence of both mate ends is

    62	  `Γ`-level statement for the constant curve `C_A`, and

    68	## The route the probe identified — EXECUTED, with one simplification

    71	`Picard/RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange.lean`.  The route below is what that file follows, with
    72	one departure worth reading before trusting the corrections in the next section: steps 1–2 were

   161	## Four corrections to that route, from an adversarial re-check
   162	
   163	The route above survived an independent verification of §1–§4, but four of its *unproved*
   164	steps were found to be booked at less than they cost.  Recorded so the next session does not
   165	rediscover them:
   166	
   167	1. **Take the engine's fourth conjunct directly; do not re-derive it.**  Step 1 above proposes
   168	   feeding global surjectivity of `d` to `bijective_kerBaseChange_of_surjective`
   169	   (`Picard/TwoTermFiniteFree.lean`:392), which then also demands
   170	   `Module.Flat Γ(Spec A, ⊤) Γ(M, U₁ ⊓ U₂)`.  That is unnecessary: the fourth conjunct of
   171	   `p1Cech_h0_baseChange_of_fibrewise_h1_vanishing_of_isIntegral`
   172	   (`Picard/RigidPushforwardP1Constants.lean`:540-544) is already
   173	   `∀ B, Function.Bijective (TwoTerm.kerBaseChange (…) B)` for *every*
   174	   `Γ(Spec A, ⊤)`-algebra `B`; instantiate `B := Γ(Spec A', ⊤)`.  This deletes the flatness
   175	   obligation entirely, so the intended `Γ`-level statement should take
   176	   `hker : ∀ B …, Function.Bijective (kerBaseChange (𝒰.moduleSectionDiffBase f M) B)` rather
   177	   than a flatness-plus-surjectivity pair.
   178	
   179	2. **Get the `letI` binder list right, and elaborate the statement before writing any proof.**
   180	   A `Module Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(M, ·)` instance exists only through `letI := f.baseSectionsModule M ·`,
   181	   so every hypothesis mentioning `Γ(M, ·)` as a `Γ(Y, ⊤)`-module needs one — *in addition to*
   182	   the `Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤)` binder, which is never replaced.  How many depends on the
   183	   statement, so copy from the closest existing one rather than guessing:
   184	   `surjective_moduleSectionDiffBase_baseChange_residueField`
   185	   (`Picard/RigidPushforwardFiberChart.lean`:508-518) is about the whole Čech complex and
   186	   carries the `Algebra` binder plus **three** `baseSectionsModule` binders (`U₁`, `U₂`,
   187	   `U₁ ⊓ U₂` — there is no `⊤` binder); a statement about a *single* chart needs the `Algebra`
   188	   binder plus **one**, at that chart; and the kernel comparison
   189	   `exists_kerChartTensorEquiv` (`Picard/RigidPushforwardChartBaseChange.lean`) needs **seven**
   190	   — the `Algebra` binder, three on `X`, three on `X'`.  (An earlier draft of this paragraph
   191	   said "four binders, not the `Algebra` binder", which describes none of them; corrected after
   192	   a fresh-context review checked it against the source, and the counts above are measured.)
   193	   Two traps found while writing the seven-binder version: instance search does **not** see
   194	   `g' ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.U₁` as `(𝒰.preimage g').U₁`, so the target-side binders must be spelled with
   195	   `(𝒰.preimage g').Uᵢ`; and after `TensorProduct.induction_on` a goal that is syntactically
   196	   `X = X` may still need an explicit `rfl`, because the two sides carry different-but-defeq
   197	   module instances from the `letI` dictionary.  Either way: write the statement with a
   198	   placeholder body and get it to elaborate first — that is where the time goes.
   199	
   200	3. **The glue to §3 is not free.**  §3's map lives on the tensor product formed with the
   201	   *native* pushforward module structure (that is what
   202	   `pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_sectionLinearEquiv` returns), while the Čech statement

   204	   propositionally equal: `Scheme.Modules.pushforwardTopEquivBaseSections`

   209	
   210	4. **Moving surjectivity from `π_A ≫ p` to `q` needs a lemma.**  The preimage-cover

   213	   proved by `(pullback.lift_snd _ _ _).trans (Category.comp_id _)`).  Since the module
   214	   structures sit inside the *type* of `moduleSectionDiffBase`, a naive `rw` on the morphism
   215	   equality risks a "motive is not type correct" failure; a `subst`-style congruence helper is
   216	   needed.  "Transports by `exact`" is true only within a fixed family.
   217	
   218	## Vacuity audit
   219	
   220	`RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange` is of the shape `∃ s, (value of s on simple tensors) ∧
   221	Function.Bijective s`.  This cannot be discharged by choosing a convenient `s`: simple tensors
   222	generate `Γ(Spec A', ⊤) ⊗_{Γ(Spec A, ⊤)} Γ(q_* L, ⊤)` as an abelian group, and `s` is required
   223	to be additive, so the prescribed values on simple tensors determine `s` **uniquely**.  The
   224	existential is therefore a genuine bijectivity assertion about the canonical base-change map,
   225	not an unconstrained choice.

   250	    (h : IsIso ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map φ)) : IsIso φ := by

   255	    ((Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓNatTrans (R := R)).naturality φ).symm

   313	            (g.appLE (⊤ : Y.Opens) (⊤ : Y'.Opens) le_top).hom.toAlgebra
   314	         TensorProduct Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤)
   315	             Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) →+
   316	           Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj F),
   317	             (⊤ : Y'.Opens)))
   318	    (hs : letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) :=
   319	            (g.appLE (⊤ : Y.Opens) (⊤ : Y'.Opens) le_top).hom.toAlgebra
   320	          ∀ (b : Γ(Y', ⊤)) (x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F, (⊤ : Y.Opens))),
   321	            s (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] x) =
   322	              b • (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj
   323	                  ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj F), (⊤ : Y'.Opens)) from
   324	                pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g' F e' x))
   325	    (hbij : Function.Bijective s) :
   326	    IsIso (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
   327	      (pushforwardBaseChangeMap f g f' g' comm F) (⊤ : Y'.Opens)) := by
   328	  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) :=
   329	    (g.appLE (⊤ : Y.Opens) (⊤ : Y'.Opens) le_top).hom.toAlgebra

   331	    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) (isAffineOpen_top Y') (isAffineOpen_top Y)

    33	  Module.compHom _ (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U)

    47	  obj U := ModuleCat.of k Γ(M, U.unop)

    52	        (Scheme.Modules.map_smul M f.unop (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U.unop r) x).trans

   236	/-- **The class of an anchored datum**: a datum whose transition units are the
   237	restricted pair values of a unit cocycle `γ` on a pointed cover `𝒰` (along an anchor
   238	map dominating the pieces) has Čech Picard class `CechPic.mk 𝒰 γ.class`. The
   239	comparison runs on the pointed cover `x ↦ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ pieces (σ x)`, where the two
   240	restricted cocycles are cohomologous through the `0`-cochain
   241	`x ↦ γ.evInf x (anchor (σ x))`. -/
   242	theorem cechPicClass_eq_of_anchor (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
   243	    (𝒰 : (relCurve C B).PointedCover) (γ : (relCurve C B).unitsCocycle 𝒰)

   248	          Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)) =
   249	        (relCurve C B).resHom (inf_le_inf (hanch i) (hanch j))
   250	          (Scheme.unitsEvInf γ (anchor i) (anchor j) :
   251	            Γ(relCurve C B, 𝒰.opens (anchor i) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (anchor j)))) :
   252	    D.cechPicClass = Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒰 γ.class := by
   253	  set 𝒲 : (relCurve C B).PointedCover :=
   254	    ⟨fun x => 𝒰.opens x ⊓ D.pieces (D.pieceIndex x),
   255	      fun x => ⟨𝒰.mem_opens x, D.mem_pieces_pieceIndex x⟩⟩ with h𝒲

   257	  have hsub : ∀ x : relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens x ≤ D.pieces (D.pieceIndex x) :=
   258	    fun x => inf_le_right
   259	  -- the subordinated cocycle of the datum and the restricted `γ` are cohomologous
   260	  have hcoh : (gluedSubordCocycle D.isGluingCocycle 𝒲 D.pieceIndex hsub).IsCohomologous
   261	      (γ.res fun x => homOfLE (h𝒲𝒰 x)) := by
   262	    refine Scheme.unitsCocycle_isCohomologous
   263	      (fun x => (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict
   264	        (le_inf inf_le_left (inf_le_right.trans (hanch (D.pieceIndex x))) :
   265	          𝒲.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens (anchor (D.pieceIndex x)))
   266	        (Scheme.unitsEvInf γ x (anchor (D.pieceIndex x)))) (fun x y => ?_)
   267	    refine Units.ext ?_
   268	    rw [Units.val_mul, Units.val_mul, gluedSubordCocycle_evInf,
   269	      Scheme.res_unitsEvInf h𝒲𝒰 γ x y]
   270	    simp only [coe_unitsRestrict, gluedSubordUnit, Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   271	    rw [hunit (D.pieceIndex x) (D.pieceIndex y), Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   272	    have hL := Scheme.unitsEvInf_mul_res_of_le γ x (anchor (D.pieceIndex x))
   273	      (anchor (D.pieceIndex y))
   274	      (O := 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y)
   275	      (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left)
   276	        ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans (hanch (D.pieceIndex x))))
   277	      (le_inf ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans (hanch (D.pieceIndex x)))
   278	        ((inf_le_right.trans inf_le_right).trans (hanch (D.pieceIndex y))))
   279	      (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left)
   280	        ((inf_le_right.trans inf_le_right).trans (hanch (D.pieceIndex y))))
   281	    have hR := Scheme.unitsEvInf_mul_res_of_le γ x y (anchor (D.pieceIndex y))
   282	      (O := 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y)
   283	      (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) (inf_le_right.trans inf_le_left))
   284	      (le_inf (inf_le_right.trans inf_le_left)
   285	        ((inf_le_right.trans inf_le_right).trans (hanch (D.pieceIndex y))))
   286	      (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left)
   287	        ((inf_le_right.trans inf_le_right).trans (hanch (D.pieceIndex y))))
   288	    exact hL.trans hR.symm
   289	  calc D.cechPicClass
   290	      = Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒲
   291	          (gluedSubordCocycle D.isGluingCocycle 𝒲 D.pieceIndex hsub).class :=
   292	        (D.cechPicClass_eq_mk 𝒲 D.pieceIndex hsub).symm
   293	    _ = Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒲 (γ.res fun x => homOfLE (h𝒲𝒰 x)).class :=

   295	    _ = Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒰 γ.class := Scheme.CechPic.mk_unitsRes h𝒲𝒰 γ.class

   299	class — the DAT-1 constructor input shape, on finite basic-open families of the two

   308	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B (fiberTwoCover π)).exists_finite_basicOpen_refinement 𝒰

   310	  exact cechPicClass_eq_of_anchor _ 𝒰 γ (Sum.elim an₀ an₁)

    10	/-!
    11	# Restriction of affine theta-section models
    12	
    13	This file proves the module base-change bridge needed to compare the theta modules on
    14	two members of an affine divisor cover. Its construction is intrinsic to the glued
    15	sheaf: there is no extra hypothesis on the divisor family or on the affine opens.
    16	
    17	The key geometric input is a finite basic-open cover of an affine subopen `W ≤ V`
    18	which is simultaneously subordinate to the original gluing pieces. This lets later
    19	localization arguments use the established piece-localization theorem for the glued
    20	sheaf. We package the canonical section restriction and prove that its base-change map
    21	is bijective for every inclusion of affine opens.
    22	
    23	## Main declarations
    24	
    25	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.exists_finite_basicOpen_cover_le` produces the finite
    26	  subordinate localization family;
    27	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.affineSectionsBaseChange` is the canonical comparison;
    28	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.affineSectionsBaseChange_bijective` proves that comparison is
    29	  an equivalence, without an additional hypothesis.
    30	-/

    33

    35	
    36	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
    37	open scoped TensorProduct
    38

    40	
    41	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

    53	/-- Base change in stages preserves the base-change property: if `S ⊗[R] M → N` is
    54	an equivalence, then so is `S ⊗[A] (A ⊗[R] M) → N`. -/
    55	theorem isBaseChange_liftBaseChange_of_isBaseChange
    56	    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (hf : IsBaseChange S f) :
    57	    IsBaseChange S (LinearMap.liftBaseChange A f) := by
    58	  let e : S ⊗[A] (A ⊗[R] M) ≃ₗ[S] N :=
    59	    (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange R A S S M).trans hf.equiv
    60	  apply IsBaseChange.of_equiv e
    61	  intro x
    62	  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    63	  | zero => simp
    64	  | add x y hx hy =>
    65	      rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
    66	  | tmul a m =>
    67	      change hf.equiv
    68	          ((TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange R A S S M)
    69	            (1 ⊗ₜ[A] (a ⊗ₜ[R] m))) = _
    70	      rw [TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange_tmul,
    71	        IsBaseChange.equiv_tmul, LinearMap.liftBaseChange_tmul]

    82	/-- If `W ≤ V` are affine opens, there is a finite family of basic opens of `V`
    83	covering `W`, each subordinate to a gluing piece. After restriction to `W`, their
    84	defining sections span the unit ideal of `Γ(W)`. -/
    85	theorem exists_finite_basicOpen_cover_le
    86	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    87	    {V W : (relCurve C B).Opens}
    88	    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (hWV : W ≤ V) :
    89	    ∃ (ι : Type u) (_ : Fintype ι) (f : ι → Γ(relCurve C B, V))
    90	      (anchor : ι → relCurve C B),
    91	      (∀ i, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (f i) ≤ W) ∧
    92	      (∀ i, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (f i) ≤ D.pieces (D.pieceIndex (anchor i))) ∧
    93	      Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i ↦ (relCurve C B).resHom hWV (f i))) = ⊤ := by
    94	  classical
    95	  let X := relCurve C B
    96	  have hpt : ∀ p : ↥W, ∃ f : Γ(X, V),
    97	      X.basicOpen f ≤ W ⊓ D.pieces (D.pieceIndex (p : X)) ∧
    98	        (p : X) ∈ X.basicOpen f := fun p =>
    99	    hV.exists_basicOpen_le
   100	      (⟨(p : X), p.2, D.mem_pieces_pieceIndex (p : X)⟩ :
   101	        ↥(W ⊓ D.pieces (D.pieceIndex (p : X))))
   102	      (hWV p.2)
   103	  choose f hfle hfmem using hpt
   104	  have hcov : (W : Set X) ⊆ ⋃ p : ↥W, (X.basicOpen (f p) : Set X) := fun q hq =>
   105	    Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨q, hq⟩, hfmem ⟨q, hq⟩⟩
   106	  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hW.isCompact.elim_finite_subcover
   107	    (fun p : ↥W => (X.basicOpen (f p) : Set X))
   108	    (fun p => (X.basicOpen (f p)).isOpen) hcov
   109	  let ι := {p : ↥W // p ∈ t}
   110	  let f' : ι → Γ(X, V) := fun i => f (i : ↥W)
   111	  let anchor : ι → X := fun i => ((i : ↥W) : X)
   112	  have hfW (i : ι) : X.basicOpen (f' i) ≤ W :=
   113	    (hfle (i : ↥W)).trans inf_le_left
   114	  have hfP (i : ι) : X.basicOpen (f' i) ≤ D.pieces (D.pieceIndex (anchor i)) :=
   115	    (hfle (i : ↥W)).trans inf_le_right
   116	  refine ⟨ι, inferInstance, f', anchor, hfW, hfP, ?_⟩
   117	  apply hW.self_le_iSup_basicOpen_iff.mp
   118	  intro q hq
   119	  obtain ⟨p, hpt, hpq⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (ht hq)
   120	  let i : ι := ⟨p, hpt⟩
   121	  apply TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr
   122	  refine ⟨⟨X.resHom hWV (f' i), Set.mem_range_self i⟩, ?_⟩
   123	  rw [Scheme.basicOpen_resHom hWV]
   124	  exact ⟨hq, hpq⟩

   139	      D.sheaf.obj.obj (op W) := by

    12	/-!
    13	# Invertible sections of a cocycle-glued line bundle on an affine open
    14	
    15	The cocycle pieces used to construct `gluedSheaf` need not contain an arbitrary affine
    16	open.  Nevertheless, every affine open admits a finite basic-open refinement subordinate
    17	to the canonical pointed cover by those pieces.  On each refined basic open the glued
    18	sheaf is free of rank one.  The existing localization-span engine then proves that its
    19	sections on the original affine open are finite projective.
    20	
    21	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.AffineSectionsModel` packages the quasi-coherent action chosen by
    22	that internal refinement together with the finite, projective, and invertible instances.
    23	Returning a `Nonempty` model keeps the refinement choice noncomputable while giving
    24	downstream code a single datum from which it can install all four compatible instances.
    25	
    26	This is the chart-free line-bundle substrate needed to restrict a positive theta twist to
    27	the arbitrary affine pieces of `AffAdaptation`: the divisor cover is not required to lie in
    28	either pinned theta chart.
    29	-/

import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.GluedSheafDatum

/-!
# Base change of the pinned cocycle datum (DAT-1, stage 1d-ii, the datum half)

The `relCocycleBaseChange`-style base change of the basic-open cocycle datum
(`informal/spec-dat-1.md` stage (1d-ii), first bullet; worksheet §3.2 — **this is the
RE-5 transport interface**): along a `k`-algebra map `B → B'`, the generators, partition
coefficients and transition units of a `Scheme.BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π` push forward
through the relative-curve comparison morphism `relCurveMap C B B'` to a datum over `B'`,
with the pieces mapping to pieces (`Scheme.preimage_basicOpen`) and the partition/cocycle
identities carried by `map_*`.

* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom` — `appLE` commutes with restriction on
  both sides (the workhorse; both sides collapse to one `appLE` by
  `appLE_map`/`map_appLE` and proof irrelevance).
* `relSectionsMap_basicOpen` — basic opens of compared sections are preimages of basic
  opens.
* `relCurveMap_appLE_overAlgebraMap` — the comparison intertwines the structure algebra
  maps along `algebraMap B B'`, over **arbitrary** opens (the pullback-open case is the
  landed `relSectionsMap_overAlgebraMap`).
* `BasicOpenCoverData.baseChange` / `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.baseChange` — the datum base
  change, with `pieces_baseChange` (pieces map to pieces).
* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sectionsMap` — the componentwise comparison of glued sections
  `F_D(W) → F_{D'}(W')` for `W' ≤ relCurveMap ⁻¹ᵁ W`, additive
  (`sectionsMap_add`), semilinear along `algebraMap B B'` (`sectionsMap_smul`),
  commuting with restriction (`gluedRes_sectionsMap`), intertwining the piece
  trivializations with the section comparison (`gluedTriv_sectionsMap`) and the
  componentwise chart actions (`sectionsMap_gluedQsmul`) — the inputs of the stage
  (1d-ii) term identifications and the RE-5 transport.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
/- Statements mix `Γ(relCurve C B, ·)` with opens produced on the product spelling
`(C ⊗ overSpec k B).left`; see `AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RelativeSectionsLinear`. -/
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory TopologicalSpace
open Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

/-! ## `appLE` against restriction, on arbitrary opens -/

/-- **`appLE` commutes with restriction**: for `f : X ⟶ Y`, restricting the `appLE`
image of a section equals the `appLE` image of the restricted section. Both sides are
`f.appLE W PW'` of the section, by `appLE_map`/`map_appLE` and proof irrelevance of the
inclusion witnesses. -/
lemma Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X.Hom Y) {W' W : Y.Opens}
    {PW' PW : X.Opens} (hW : W' ≤ W) (ePW : PW ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ W) (ePW' : PW' ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ W')
    (hP : PW' ≤ PW) (s : Γ(Y, W)) :
    X.resHom hP ((f.appLE W PW ePW).hom s) =
      (f.appLE W' PW' ePW').hom (Y.resHom hW s) := by
  have h1 := congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    $(Scheme.Hom.appLE_map f ePW (homOfLE hP).op)) s)
  have h2 := congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    $(Scheme.Hom.map_appLE f ePW' (homOfLE hW).op)) s)
  exact h1.trans h2.symm

section BasicOpen

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
variable (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
variable (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B'] [IsScalarTower k B B']

/-! ## Basic opens of compared sections -/

/-- **Basic opens base-change to basic opens**: the basic open of the compared section
`relSectionsMap s` is the `relCurveMap`-preimage of the basic open of `s`. -/
theorem relSectionsMap_basicOpen (V : C.left.Opens)
    (s : Γ(relCurve C B, (fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :
    (relCurve C B').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C B B' V s) =
      relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ ((relCurve C B).basicOpen s) := by
  have happ : relSectionsMap C B B' V s =
      (relCurve C B').resHom
        (le_of_eq (relCurveMap_preimage C B B' V).symm :
          (fst C (overSpec k B')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤
            relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
        (((relCurveMap C B B').app ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)).hom s) := by
    have h := congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom
      $(Scheme.Hom.appLE_map (relCurveMap C B B')
        (le_refl (relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)))
        (homOfLE (le_of_eq (relCurveMap_preimage C B B' V).symm)).op)) s)
    have h0 : ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
        (relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)) le_rfl).hom s =
        (((relCurveMap C B B').app ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)).hom s) :=
      congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom
        $(Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app (relCurveMap C B B')
          (U := (fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))) s)
    calc relSectionsMap C B B' V s
        = ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
            ((fst C (overSpec k B')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
            (le_of_eq (relCurveMap_preimage C B B' V).symm)).hom s := rfl
      _ = (relCurve C B').resHom (le_of_eq (relCurveMap_preimage C B B' V).symm)
            (((relCurveMap C B B').appLE ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
              (relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
              le_rfl).hom s) := h.symm
      _ = _ := by rw [h0]
  rw [happ, Scheme.basicOpen_resHom,
    ← Scheme.preimage_basicOpen (relCurveMap C B B') s,
    ← relCurveMap_preimage C B B' V, ← Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
  congr 1
  exact inf_eq_right.mpr ((relCurve C B).basicOpen_le s)

/-! ## The comparison intertwines the structure algebra maps (arbitrary opens) -/

/-- `appLE` is invariant under an equality of morphisms. -/
private lemma appLE_congr_hom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : f = g) {U : Y.Opens}
    {W : X.Opens} (e : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    f.appLE U W e = g.appLE U W (h ▸ e) := by
  subst h; rfl

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule

/-- **The comparison intertwines the structure actions, on arbitrary opens**: the
`appLE` image of the structure pullback of `r : B` is the structure pullback of
`algebraMap B B' r` (the landed `relSectionsMap_overAlgebraMap` is the pullback-open
case `W = V_B`). -/
theorem relCurveMap_appLE_overAlgebraMap {W : (relCurve C B).Opens}
    {W' : (relCurve C B').Opens} (hle : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W) (r : B) :
    ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE W W' hle).hom
        ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B W r) =
      (relCurve C B').overAlgebraMap B' W' (algebraMap B B' r) := by
  have hmor : ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).inv ≫
        (snd C (overSpec k B)).left.appLE ⊤ W
          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k B)).left).ge)) ≫
      (relCurveMap C B B').appLE W W' hle =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B B') ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B')).inv ≫
        (snd C (overSpec k B')).left.appLE ⊤ W'
          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k B')).left).ge) := by
    have hnat : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).inv ≫
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B B'))).appTop =
        CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B B') ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B')).inv := by
      rw [Iso.inv_comp_eq, ← Category.assoc,
        ← Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B B')),
        Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
    have hsplit : ((snd C (overSpec k B')).left ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B B'))).appLE ⊤ W'
          ((relCurveMap_snd C B B') ▸
            hle.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ (le_top.trans
              (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k B)).left).ge))) =
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B B'))).appLE ⊤ ⊤
            (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top _).ge ≫
          (snd C (overSpec k B')).left.appLE ⊤ W'
            (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k B')).left).ge) :=
      (Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE _ _ _ _ _ _ _).symm
    have happ : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B B'))).appLE ⊤ ⊤
        (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top _).ge =
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B B'))).appTop :=
      Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _
    rw [Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE,
      appLE_congr_hom (relCurveMap_snd C B B'), hsplit, happ, ← Category.assoc,
      hnat, Category.assoc]
  have hoam : (relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B W r =
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).inv ≫
        (snd C (overSpec k B)).left.appLE ⊤ W
          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k B)).left).ge)).hom
        r := rfl
  have hoam' : (relCurve C B').overAlgebraMap B' W' (algebraMap B B' r) =
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B')).inv ≫
        (snd C (overSpec k B')).left.appLE ⊤ W'
          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k B')).left).ge)).hom
        (algebraMap B B' r) := rfl
  rw [hoam, hoam']
  exact congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom $hmor) r)

end BasicOpen

/-! ## Base change of the datum -/

section Datum

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
variable (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B'] [IsScalarTower k B B']
variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π]

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule

namespace BasicOpenCoverData

variable (D : BasicOpenCoverData C B π)

/-- **Base change of the basic-open cover data** along `B → B'`: the generators and
partition coefficients push forward through the sections comparison map; the partition
witnesses are carried by `map_sum`/`map_mul`/`map_one`. -/
noncomputable def baseChange : BasicOpenCoverData C B' π where
  J₀ := D.J₀
  J₁ := D.J₁
  fintype₀ := D.fintype₀
  fintype₁ := D.fintype₁
  h₀ j := relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₀ π) (D.h₀ j)
  h₁ j := relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₁ π) (D.h₁ j)
  a₀ j := relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₀ π) (D.a₀ j)
  a₁ j := relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₁ π) (D.a₁ j)
  partition₀ := by
    have h := congrArg (relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₀ π)) D.partition₀
    rw [map_sum, map_one] at h
    rw [← h]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => (map_mul _ _ _).symm
  partition₁ := by
    have h := congrArg (relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₁ π)) D.partition₁
    rw [map_sum, map_one] at h
    rw [← h]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => (map_mul _ _ _).symm

@[simp]
lemma baseChange_h₀ (j : D.J₀) :
    (D.baseChange B').h₀ j = relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₀ π) (D.h₀ j) := rfl

@[simp]
lemma baseChange_h₁ (j : D.J₁) :
    (D.baseChange B').h₁ j = relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₁ π) (D.h₁ j) := rfl

/-- **Pieces base-change to pieces**: the pieces of the base-changed cover data are the
`relCurveMap`-preimages of the pieces. -/
theorem pieces_baseChange (j : D.index) :
    (D.baseChange B').pieces j = relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces j := by
  cases j with
  | inl j => exact relSectionsMap_basicOpen C B B' (fiberChart₀ π) (D.h₀ j)
  | inr j => exact relSectionsMap_basicOpen C B B' (fiberChart₁ π) (D.h₁ j)

/-- The base-changed pieces are below the preimages of the pieces (the `≤`-form of
`pieces_baseChange` consumed by `appLE`). -/
lemma baseChange_pieces_le_preimage (j : D.index) :
    (D.baseChange B').pieces j ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces j :=
  (D.pieces_baseChange B' j).le

/-- Double overlaps of base-changed pieces are below the preimages of the double
overlaps. -/
lemma baseChange_inf_le_preimage (i j : D.index) :
    (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j ≤
      relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) := by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
  exact inf_le_inf (D.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' i)
    (D.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' j)

/-- **The overlap comparison map**: sections on a double overlap of pieces compare to
sections on the double overlap of the base-changed pieces, through `appLE` of the
relative-curve comparison. -/
noncomputable def overlapMap (i j : D.index) :
    Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) →+*
      Γ(relCurve C B', (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j) :=
  ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
    ((D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j)
    (D.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i j)).hom

end BasicOpenCoverData

namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum

variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)

/-- **Base change of the pinned cocycle datum** along `B → B'` (stage (1d-ii), the
datum half; the RE-5 descent/transport interface): generators, partition coefficients
and transition units push forward through the relative-curve comparison; the cocycle
identities are carried by ring-hom functoriality (`Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom`). -/
noncomputable def baseChange : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B' π where
  toBasicOpenCoverData := D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B'
  unit i j := Units.map (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.overlapMap B' i j).toMonoidHom
    (D.unit i j)
  isGluingCocycle := by
    constructor
    · intro i
      have h := D.isGluingCocycle.unit_self i
      change (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.overlapMap B' i i)
        ((D.unit i i : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces i))) = 1
      rw [h, map_one]
    · intro i j l
      -- the triple overlap of the base-changed pieces sits below the preimage of the
      -- triple overlap
      have htriple : (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓
            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces j ⊓
            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces l ≤
          relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l) := by
        rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
        exact inf_le_inf (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i j)
          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' l)
      have key := congrArg
        (((relCurveMap C B B').appLE (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l)
          ((D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓
            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces j ⊓
            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces l) htriple).hom)
        (D.isGluingCocycle.mul_res i j l)
      rw [map_mul] at key
      have e₁ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
        (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l ≤ D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i j) htriple
        (inf_le_left : (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓
          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces j ⊓
          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces l ≤
          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓
            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces j)
        ((D.unit i j : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)))
      have e₂ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
        (gluedInclCoc D.pieces (D.pieces i) j l)
        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' j l) htriple
        (gluedInclCoc (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces
          ((D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i) j l)
        ((D.unit j l : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l)))
      have e₃ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
        (gluedInclSnd D.pieces (D.pieces i) j l)
        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i l) htriple
        (gluedInclSnd (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces
          ((D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i) j l)
        ((D.unit i l : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces l)))
      rw [← e₁, ← e₂, ← e₃] at key
      simp only [Units.coe_map]
      exact key

@[simp]
lemma baseChange_unit_coe (i j : D.index) :
    (((D.baseChange B').unit i j :
        Γ(relCurve C B',
          (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j)ˣ) :
      Γ(relCurve C B', (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j)) =
      D.toBasicOpenCoverData.overlapMap B' i j
        ((D.unit i j : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j))) := rfl

/-! ## The componentwise comparison of glued sections -/

section SectionsMap

variable {W : (relCurve C B).Opens} {W' : (relCurve C B').Opens}

/-- The component opens of the comparison sit below the preimages of the component
opens. -/
lemma sectionsMap_component_le (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W) (j : D.index) :
    W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ (W ⊓ D.pieces j) := by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
  exact inf_le_inf hW' (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' j)

/-- **The componentwise comparison of glued sections** along `B → B'`: apply `appLE` of
the relative-curve comparison to every component. Matching is carried by
`Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom` and the base-changed units. -/
noncomputable def sectionsMap (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W)) :
    ↥(gluedSubmodule B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit W') := by
  refine ⟨fun j => ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE (W ⊓ D.pieces j)
    (W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j) (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' j)).hom
    (s.val j), ?_⟩
  intro i j
  have hdouble : W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j ≤
      relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ (W ⊓ D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
    exact inf_le_inf (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' i)
      (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' j)
  have key := congrArg
    (((relCurveMap C B B').appLE (W ⊓ D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
      (W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j) hdouble).hom)
    ((mem_gluedSubmodule_iff B D.pieces D.unit
      (s.val : ∀ l : D.index, Γ(relCurve C B, W ⊓ D.pieces l))).mp s.property i j)
  rw [map_mul] at key
  have e₁ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
    (inf_le_left : W ⊓ D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ W ⊓ D.pieces i)
    (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' i) hdouble
    (inf_le_left : W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j ≤
      W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces i) (s.val i)
  have e₂ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
    (gluedInclCoc D.pieces W i j)
    (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i j) hdouble
    (gluedInclCoc (D.baseChange B').pieces W' i j)
    ((D.unit i j : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)))
  have e₃ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
    (gluedInclSnd D.pieces W i j)
    (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' j) hdouble
    (gluedInclSnd (D.baseChange B').pieces W' i j) (s.val j)
  rw [← e₁, ← e₂, ← e₃] at key
  exact key

@[simp]
lemma sectionsMap_coe (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W)) (j : D.index) :
    (D.sectionsMap B' hW' s).val j =
      ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE (W ⊓ D.pieces j)
        (W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j)
        (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' j)).hom (s.val j) := rfl

/-- The comparison of glued sections is additive. -/
lemma sectionsMap_add (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    (s t : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W)) :
    D.sectionsMap B' hW' (s + t) = D.sectionsMap B' hW' s + D.sectionsMap B' hW' t := by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun j => ?_)
  have hst : (s + t).val j = s.val j + t.val j := rfl
  have hst' : (D.sectionsMap B' hW' s + D.sectionsMap B' hW' t).val j =
      (D.sectionsMap B' hW' s).val j + (D.sectionsMap B' hW' t).val j := rfl
  rw [hst', sectionsMap_coe, sectionsMap_coe, sectionsMap_coe, hst, map_add]

/-- **Semilinearity of the comparison of glued sections**: it intertwines the
coefficient actions along `algebraMap B B'`. -/
lemma sectionsMap_smul (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W) (b : B)
    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W)) :
    D.sectionsMap B' hW' (b • s) = algebraMap B B' b • D.sectionsMap B' hW' s := by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun j => ?_)
  have hbs : ((b • s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W))).val j = b • s.val j := rfl
  have hbs' : ((algebraMap B B' b • D.sectionsMap B' hW' s :
      ↥(gluedSubmodule B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit W'))).val j =
      algebraMap B B' b • (D.sectionsMap B' hW' s).val j := rfl
  rw [hbs', sectionsMap_coe, sectionsMap_coe, hbs, Scheme.overModule_smul_def,
    Scheme.overModule_smul_def, map_mul]
  congr 1
  exact relCurveMap_appLE_overAlgebraMap C B B' _ b

/-- The comparison of glued sections commutes with restriction. -/
lemma gluedRes_sectionsMap {V' V : (relCurve C B).Opens} (hV'V : V' ≤ V)
    {P' P : (relCurve C B').Opens} (hP : P ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (hP' : P' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ V') (hPP : P' ≤ P)
    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit V)) :
    gluedRes B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit hPP
        (D.sectionsMap B' hP s) =
      D.sectionsMap B' hP' (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit hV'V s) := by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun j => ?_)
  rw [gluedRes_coe, sectionsMap_coe, sectionsMap_coe, gluedRes_coe]
  exact (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
    (inf_le_inf_right (D.pieces j) hV'V) (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hP j)
    (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hP' j)
    (inf_le_inf_right ((D.baseChange B').pieces j) hPP) (s.val j)

/-- **The comparison intertwines the piece trivializations with `appLE`**: on an open
below a piece, trivializing the compared section is `appLE` of the trivialized
section. -/
lemma gluedTriv_sectionsMap (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W) {j : D.index}
    (hWj : W ≤ D.pieces j) (hW'j : W' ≤ (D.baseChange B').pieces j)
    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W)) :
    gluedTriv B' (D.baseChange B').isGluingCocycle j hW'j (D.sectionsMap B' hW' s) =
      ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE W W'
        (hW'.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ le_rfl))).hom
        (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j hWj s) := by
  rw [gluedTriv_apply, gluedTriv_apply, sectionsMap_coe]
  exact (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom (le_inf le_rfl hWj)
    (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' j) (hW'.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ le_rfl))
    (le_inf le_rfl hW'j) (s.val j)

/-- **The comparison intertwines the componentwise chart actions**: acting by
`r ∈ Γ(C_B, V)` then comparing equals comparing then acting by the compared scalar. -/
lemma sectionsMap_gluedQsmul {V : (relCurve C B).Opens} {V' : (relCurve C B').Opens}
    (hWV : W ≤ V) (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    (hV' : V' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ V) (hW'V' : W' ≤ V') (r : Γ(relCurve C B, V))
    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W)) :
    D.sectionsMap B' hW' (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit hWV r s) =
      gluedQsmul B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit hW'V'
        (((relCurveMap C B B').appLE V V' hV').hom r) (D.sectionsMap B' hW' s) := by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun j => ?_)
  rw [sectionsMap_coe, gluedQsmul_coe, gluedQsmul_coe, sectionsMap_coe, map_mul]
  congr 1
  exact ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom (inf_le_left.trans hWV) hV'
    (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' j) (inf_le_left.trans hW'V') r).symm

end SectionsMap

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneLocus

/-!
# The native module carried by a glued rank-one datum

`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sheaf` is already a sheaf of modules over the coefficient
ring.  The presentation contract also asks for the same object as a sheaf of
modules over the structure sheaf of the relative curve.  This file supplies
that bridge: the componentwise `gluedQsmul` action gives a module on every open,
`gluedRes_gluedQsmul` gives the semilinearity needed by
`PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf`, and `gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap` identifies its
restriction to the coefficient ring with the original datum sheaf.

The canonical piece trivializations also prove that the native module is a line
bundle.  Pushforward base-change and existence of a tied
`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` remain genuine producer obligations.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]

namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum

noncomputable section

variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)

/-- The structure-sheaf module on the sections of the glued datum over one open.

The action is the componentwise multiplication action; the four module laws
are inherited from the corresponding `gluedQsmul` identities. -/
@[reducible] noncomputable def moduleOn (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
    Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
      ((D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)).obj (op U)) := by
  change Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U))
  letI : SMul Γ(relCurve C B, U)
      (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U)) :=
    ⟨fun r s => gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s⟩
  exact Module.ofMinimalAxioms
    (fun r x y => gluedQsmul_add B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r x y)
    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_add_left B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_mul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
    (fun x => gluedQsmul_one B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) x)

/-- The presheaf of structure-sheaf modules underlying `D`. -/
noncomputable def nativePresheaf : (relCurve C B).PresheafOfModules := by
  let M : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat :=
    D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)
  let family : ∀ U : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ,
      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) :=
    fun U => moduleOn D U.unop
  letI : ∀ U : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ,
      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) := family
  exact PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf M (by
    intro X Y f r m
    change gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le
        (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : X.unop ≤ X.unop) r m) =
      gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : Y.unop ≤ Y.unop)
        ((relCurve C B).resHom f.unop.le r)
        (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le m)
    rw [gluedRes_gluedQsmul]
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext j
    rw [gluedQsmul_coe, gluedQsmul_coe]
    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom])

/-- The native `Scheme.Modules` object associated to a glued datum. -/
noncomputable def nativeModule : (relCurve C B).Modules := by
  refine ⟨nativePresheaf D, ?_⟩
  rw [show (nativePresheaf D).presheaf =
    D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat) from rfl]
  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
  convert (Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{u} B))).mp D.sheaf.property using 1
  all_goals rfl

/-! ## Piecewise line-bundle trivializations -/

/-- Sections of the native module over one cocycle piece are the structure-ring sections.

The open-immersion ring equivalence transports the component trivialization from the ambient
relative curve to the restricted scheme.  The `gluedTriv_gluedQsmul` identity is exactly the
structure-sheaf semilinearity needed for this to be a linear equivalence over the restricted
ring of sections. -/
noncomputable def nativeModulePieceSectionsEquiv
    (j : D.index) (V : (D.pieces j).toScheme.Opens) :
    Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (D.pieces j).ι).obj (nativeModule D), V) ≃ₗ[
      Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V)] Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V) := by
  let e := gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V)
  let ρ := ((D.pieces j).ι.appIso V).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let f : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (D.pieces j).ι).obj (nativeModule D), V) →ₗ[
      Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V)] Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V) :=
    { toFun := fun s => ρ (e s)
      map_add' := by
        intro s t
        change ρ (e (s + t)) = ρ (e s) + ρ (e t)
        change ρ (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) (s + t)) =
          ρ (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) s) +
            ρ (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) t)
        rw [show gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) (s + t) =
            gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) s +
              gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) t by
              exact (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V)).map_add s t]
        exact ρ.map_add _ _
      map_smul' := by
        intro r s
        change ρ
            (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V)
              (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl) (ρ.symm r) s)) =
          r * ρ
            (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) s)
        rw [gluedTriv_gluedQsmul]
        simp [ρ] }
  apply LinearEquiv.ofBijective f
  constructor
  · intro s t h
    have h' := congrArg ρ.symm h
    dsimp [f] at h'
    rw [ρ.symm_apply_apply, ρ.symm_apply_apply] at h'
    exact (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V)).injective h'
  · intro r
    refine ⟨e.symm (ρ.symm r), ?_⟩
    change ρ (e (e.symm (ρ.symm r))) = r
    rw [e.apply_symm_apply, ρ.apply_symm_apply]

/-- The piecewise section equivalences assemble to a sheaf isomorphism with the unit module. -/
noncomputable def nativeModulePieceSheafIso (j : D.index) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (D.pieces j).ι).obj (nativeModule D) ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit (D.pieces j).toScheme.ringCatSheaf :=
  (SheafOfModules.fullyFaithfulForget _).preimageIso
    (PresheafOfModules.isoMk
      (fun V => (nativeModulePieceSectionsEquiv D j V.unop).toModuleIso)
      (fun {V W} f => by
        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro x
        change
          ((D.pieces j).ι.appIso W.unop).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
              (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le W.unop)
                (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit
                  ((D.pieces j).ι.image_mono (leOfHom f.unop)) x)) =
            (D.pieces j).toScheme.presheaf.map f
              (((D.pieces j).ι.appIso V.unop).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
                (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V.unop) x))
        rw [gluedTriv_res B D.isGluingCocycle j
          ((D.pieces j).ι.image_mono (leOfHom f.unop))
          ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V.unop) x]
        simp only [Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso]
        change
          (relCurve C B).resHom
              ((D.pieces j).ι.image_mono (leOfHom f.unop))
              (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j
                ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V.unop) x) =
            (relCurve C B).presheaf.map
              ((D.pieces j).ι.opensFunctor.map f.unop).op
              (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j
                ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V.unop) x)
        rfl))

/-- The canonical native module is locally a free rank-one structure-sheaf module. -/
theorem nativeModule_isLineBundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle (nativeModule D) := by
  intro x
  let j := D.pieceIndex x
  refine ⟨D.pieces j, D.mem_pieces_pieceIndex x, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨nativeModulePieceSheafIso D j⟩

/-- On every open, restricting `D.nativeModule` to the coefficient ring recovers
the datum's original module of sections.

The equivalence is the identity on sections. Its linearity is the substantive
point: `gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap` identifies the native structure-sheaf action
of a coefficient scalar with the datum's coefficient action. -/
noncomputable def nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv
    (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
    (Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
      (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D)).obj.obj (op U) ≃ₗ[B]
      D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) := by
  let f :
      (Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
        (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D)).obj.obj (op U) →ₗ[B]
        D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) :=
    { toFun := fun x => x
      map_add' := by
        intros
        rfl
      map_smul' := by
        intro r x
        change gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U)
            ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B U r) x =
          r • (show D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) from x)
        exact gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap B D.pieces D.unit
          (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r x }
  exact LinearEquiv.ofBijective f ⟨fun _ _ h => h, fun y => ⟨y, rfl⟩⟩

/-- The base-ring sheaf of `D.nativeModule` is canonically the datum sheaf.

This has exactly the type of `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.module_iso` when the
presentation's native module is chosen to be `D.nativeModule`. -/
noncomputable def nativeModuleKSheafIso :
    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
      (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D) ≅ D.sheaf :=
  (fullyFaithfulSheafToPresheaf _ _).preimageIso
    (NatIso.ofComponents
      (fun U => (nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv D U.unop).toModuleIso)
      (fun {_ _} _ => by
        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro x
        rfl))

end

   158	/-- The base change of the two-cover degree-zero term `F(V₀ᴮ) × F(V₁ᴮ)`. -/
   159	noncomputable def datumDomBaseChange :
   160	    B' ⊗[B] ((D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   161	        (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))) ≃ₗ[B']

   167	/-- The degree-zero term base change on a pure tensor. -/
   168	lemma datumDomBaseChange_tmul (b' : B')

   173	  rw [datumDomBaseChange, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, TensorProduct.prodRight_tmul]
   174	  rfl

   178	/-- **The δ-naturality square** (the glued analogue of `relTwistDiffBaseChange`): the base
   179	change of the datum's Čech differential over `B` is carried to the datum's Čech differential
   180	over `B'` under the term identifications. There is no cocycle conjugation — the componentwise
   181	restrictions commute with `sectionsMap` through `gluedRes_sectionsMap`. -/
   182	theorem datumDiffBaseChange
   183	    (x : B' ⊗[B] ((D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   184	      (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)))) :
   185	    D.termBaseChangeInf B' (((datumPair D).diff).baseChange B' x) =
   186	      (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff (D.datumDomBaseChange B' x) := by
   187	  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
   188	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
   189	  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
   190	  | tmul b' p =>
   191	    have hbc : ((datumPair D).diff).baseChange B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p) =
   192	        b' ⊗ₜ[B] (datumPair D).diff p := LinearMap.baseChange_tmul _ _ _
   193	    rw [hbc]
   194	    simp only [D.datumDomBaseChange_tmul B', TwoLatticePair.diff_apply,
   195	      D.termBaseChange₀_tmul B', D.termBaseChange₁_tmul B']
   196	    rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, map_sub, D.termBaseChangeInf_tmul B',
   197	      D.termBaseChangeInf_tmul B', map_smul, map_smul]
   198	    congr 1
   199	    · congr 1
   200	      exact (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap B'
   201	        (inf_le_left : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   202	          (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
   203	        (le_preimage_chart B' (fiberTwoCover π).V₀)
   204	        (le_preimage_chart B' ((fiberTwoCover π).V₀ ⊓ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁))
   205	        (inf_le_left : (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   206	          (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
   207	        p.1).symm
   208	    · congr 1
   209	      exact (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap B'
   210	        (inf_le_right : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   211	          (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
   212	        (le_preimage_chart B' (fiberTwoCover π).V₁)
   213	        (le_preimage_chart B' ((fiberTwoCover π).V₀ ⊓ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁))
   214	        (inf_le_right : (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   215	          (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
   216	        p.2).symm
   217	
   218	/-! ## The on-the-nose H⁰ base change and H¹ vanishing -/
   219	
   220	open AlgebraicJacobian
   221	
   222	/-- **`H⁰` base change on the nose** (DAT-1 (1d-ii) tail; the RE-5/DAT-B transport interface):
   223	on the vanishing locus, for every ring map `B → B'`,
   224	
   225	`B' ⊗[B] H⁰(C_B, F_D) ≃ₗ[B'] H⁰(C_{B'}, F_{D'})`
   226	
   227	with `D' = D.baseChange B'` — the abstract kernel clause `datumH0BaseChangeEquiv` threaded
   228	through the term identifications by the δ-naturality square `datumDiffBaseChange`. -/
   229	noncomputable def datumH0BaseChange (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1) :
   230	    B' ⊗[B] (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) ≃ₗ[B']
   231	      Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 0 :=
   232	  (datumH0BaseChangeEquiv D hH1 B').trans
   233	    ((RigidEngine.kerCongr ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange B')
   234	        ((datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff)
   235	        (D.datumDomBaseChange B') (D.termBaseChangeInf B')
   236	        (fun x => D.datumDiffBaseChange B' x)).trans
   237	      ((D.baseChange B').pairData.h0Equiv
   238	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   239	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   240	        (relCover_sup C B' (fiberTwoCover π))).symm)
   241	
   242	/-- **`H¹` vanishes after base change** on the vanishing locus: the base-changed Čech
   243	differential is surjective (right-exactness of `B' ⊗[B] -` plus the δ-square), so `H¹` of the
   244	base-changed datum sheaf vanishes. -/
   245	theorem datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1) :
   246	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 1) := by
   247	  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (datumPair D).diff :=
   248	    D.pairData.surjective_diff (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover π))
   249	      (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B (fiberTwoCover π)) hH1
   250	  have hbc : Function.Surjective ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange B') := by
   251	    rw [LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor]
   252	    exact LinearMap.lTensor_surjective B' hsurj
   253	  have hsurj' : Function.Surjective (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff :=
   254	    RigidEngine.surjective_congr _ _ (D.datumDomBaseChange B') (D.termBaseChangeInf B')
   255	      (fun x => D.datumDiffBaseChange B' x) hbc

    10	# Affine-target descent for the pushforward base-change mate
    11	
    12	The B3 campaign gate `Scheme.HasRigidPushforward` (`Picard/RigidPushforward.lean`:373) has two
    13	fields.  `Picard/RigidPushforwardGate.lean` ("Caveat on the `baseChange` field") and
    14	`Picard/RigidPushforwardFrontier.lean` (item 3 of "What remains") both record that the second
    15	one, `Scheme.RigidPushforwardBaseChange` (`Picard/RigidPushforward.lean`:342), has **no
    16	infrastructure at all**: every `IsIso` theorem for the adjoint mate `pushforwardBaseChangeMap`
    17	in this tree (`isIso_pushforwardBaseChangeMap_of_isPullback`,
    18	`Picard/RigidPushforwardTransfer.lean`:1108, and its chart form :949) assumes `[IsAffineHom f]`,
    19	whereas the gate's family `q : C_A ⟶ Spec A` is proper and emphatically not affine.
    20	
    21	This file replaces "no infrastructure" by a named, honest **reduction**: the whole field follows
    22	from a single classical `H⁰`-base-change bijectivity of `Γ(Spec A, ⊤)`-modules.  It does not
    23	prove that bijectivity; `Picard/RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange.lean` does
    24	(`Adelic.rigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange_proved`), by the route sketched below.  It does not
    25	smuggle in the non-affine case either: only the two *bases* of the square are assumed affine,
    26	the fibre map `f` is arbitrary.
    27	
    28	## The reduction, in four steps
    29	
    30	* **§1 — affine-target descent.**  `Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isIso_moduleSpecΓFunctor_map` and
    31	  `Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_bijective_appTop`: a morphism `φ : M ⟶ N` of quasi-coherent modules
    32	  on an affine scheme is an isomorphism as soon as it is *bijective on global sections*.  The
    33	  input is the affine structure theorem `Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent`
    34	  (Stacks 01I8, `Picard/QuotScheme.lean`:2693) — the counit `Γ(M, ⊤)~ ⟶ M` is an isomorphism
    35	  for quasi-coherent `M` — together with naturality of `Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓNatTrans`.
    36	  Naturality rewrites `φ` as `fromTildeΓ_M⁻¹ ≫ (Γφ)~ ≫ fromTildeΓ_N`, a composite of three
    37	  isomorphisms, and the resulting `Iso` has `φ` as its `hom` by `rfl`.
    38	
    39	* **§2 — the mate on global sections.**  `isIso_pushforwardBaseChangeMap_appTop_of_bijective`:
    40	  over affine bases the `Γ(⊤)`-component of `pushforwardBaseChangeMap` *is* the canonical map
    41	  `Γ(Y', ⊤) ⊗_{Γ(Y, ⊤)} Γ(f_* F, ⊤) → Γ(f'_* (g'^* F), ⊤)`, `b ⊗ x ↦ b · baseMap x`.  The
    42	  source side is identified with the tensor product by
    43	  `pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_sectionLinearEquiv` (`Picard/QuotScheme.lean`:4611) and the
    44	  formula for the mate on the image of `baseMap` is `pushforwardBaseChangeMap_app_baseMap`
    45	  (`Picard/RigidPushforwardTransfer.lean`:828) taken at `V = O = ⊤`; simple tensors are handled
    46	  by `b ⊗ x = b • (1 ⊗ x)` and `Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul`, and `TensorProduct.induction_on`
    47	  propagates.
    48	
    49	  **Caveat, stated once and meant.**  §2 and §3 assume only `comm : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g`; the square
    50	  is *not* assumed cartesian.  They are therefore exactly as strong as the bijectivity `hbij`
    51	  handed to them, and must **not** be read as an unconditional Beck–Chevalley/base-change
    52	  theorem: all the mathematical content of a base-change theorem still sits inside `hbij`, and
    53	  without a cartesian square there is no reason for `hbij` to hold at all.
    54	
    55	* **§3 — the two combined.**  `isIso_pushforwardBaseChangeMap_of_bijective_gamma`: with `Y`
    56	  affine and the target of `g` of the form `Spec R'`, quasi-coherence of both mate ends is
    57	  automatic (`pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom`, `Scheme.Modules.pushforward_isQuasicoherent`), so
    58	  §1 upgrades the `Γ(⊤)`-bijectivity of §2 to `IsIso` of the mate itself.  **`f` is still not
    59	  assumed affine** — this is precisely the case the two frontier docstrings report as missing.
    60	
    61	* **§4 — the gate's field.**  `Adelic.RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange` names the residual
    62	  `Γ`-level statement for the constant curve `C_A`, and
    63	  `Adelic.rigidPushforwardBaseChange_of_gamma` derives `Scheme.RigidPushforwardBaseChange C A`
    64	  from it.  Properness of `C.hom` enters only through
    65	  `MorphismProperty.pullback_snd`, to know that the two pullback families are proper (hence qcqs)
    66	  and that `q_* L` is quasi-coherent.
    67	
    68	## The route the probe identified — EXECUTED, with one simplification
    69	
    70	`RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange C A` is not proved *here*; it is proved in
    71	`Picard/RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange.lean`.  The route below is what that file follows, with
    72	one departure worth reading before trusting the corrections in the next section: steps 1–2 were
    73	taken in the *opposite* order to correction 1's advice, and correction 4 turned out to be
    74	unnecessary (see the note at the end of this section).  The route as found:
    75	
    76	1. Work on the 2-affine cover `(p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).preimage π_A` of `C_A`, the preimage
    77	   under the finite (hence affine) `π_A := finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C` of the standard 2-chart
    78	   cover of `ℙ¹_A`.  Its Čech differential is **definitionally** the `ℙ¹_A` differential of
    79	   `(π_A)_* L`: `Scheme.AffineCoverMVSquare.moduleSectionDiff_pushforward`
    80	   (`Picard/RigidPushforwardTransfer.lean`:577) is proved by `rfl`.  So surjectivity of `d`
    81	   obtained on `ℙ¹_A` transports to `C_A` by `exact`, with no transport lemma at all.
    82	
    83	2. Feed that surjectivity to `bijective_kerBaseChange_of_surjective`
    84	   (`Picard/TwoTermFiniteFree.lean`:392) to get bijectivity of the kernel base-change map, and
    85	   convert kernels to global sections on *both* sides with
    86	   `Scheme.AffineCoverMVSquare.globalSectionsEquivKerModuleSectionDiffBase`
    87	   (`Picard/RigidPushforwardP1Engine.lean`:287).
    88	
    89	3. **This step is now DONE** — see `Picard/RigidPushforwardChartBaseChange.lean`, which proves
    90	   the **Čech square for an arbitrary affine base change**, i.e. the generalisation of
    91	   `Picard/RigidPushforwardFiberChart.lean` §5–§7 from the fibre embedding `Spec κ(t) ⟶ Spec A`
    92	   to an arbitrary `Spec A' ⟶ Spec A`:
    93	
    94	   * `isPushout_appLE_chartBaseChange` — the general-square replacement for
    95	     `isPushout_appLE_fiberChart` (a one-liner from `isPushout_appLE_of_isPullback'`);
    96	   * `exists_chartTensorEquiv` (↝ `exists_fiberChartTensorEquiv`) and
    97	     `chart_smul_baseMap_res` (↝ `fiberChart_smul_baseMap_res`);
    98	   * `exists_kerChartTensorEquiv` — the two-chart Čech square concluded on **kernels**,
    99	     `Γ(Y',⊤) ⊗_{Γ(Y,⊤)} ker d ≃+ ker d'`, taking the `hker` of correction 1 directly and
   100	     therefore carrying **no** flatness hypothesis.
   101
